tools.name: fix_scan
tools.description: Turn a scanned book (PDF or DjVu, up to 1,000 pages) into a clean, searchable PDF for e-readers: pages cropped to the text, straightened, sharp black and white, two-page spreads split, and searchable text added. Use it when the user wants to fix, clean up, OCR or convert a scan for a Kindle, Kobo, r

tools.name: create_upload_link
tools.description: Get a link where the user uploads a scanned PDF or DjVu from their device. Use it when you cannot pass the user's file to fix_scan: no attachment, a file too large to attach, or a file attached in a chat that cannot hand attachments to tools. Show the user the link; when they say it is uploaded, cal

tools.name: preview_scan
tools.description: Show what FixMyScan will do before converting: before-and-after images of 3 pages of the user's own book. Use it when the user wants to see the result first. Give the same source as fix_scan, or the scan_id of a book not yet converted. The first call returns at once; call again with the scan_id afte

tools.name: get_scan_status
tools.description: Check one book: its stage, pages done of the total, and the download link once it is ready. Use it after fix_scan or preview_scan, or when the user asks how their book is doing. While a book is converting, call again every 10 to 20 seconds.

tools.name: list_my_scans
tools.description: List the user's recent books on FixMyScan with their state, and download links for finished ones. Use it when the user asks about their books or you need a scan_id. Files are deleted 24 hours after a book is ready.

tools.name: cancel_scan
tools.description: Stop a book that is converting or waiting to start. Use it only when the user asks to stop or cancel it. A cancelled book does not count as used.

tools.name: delete_scan
tools.description: Delete a book's upload and finished files from FixMyScan now, rather than after 24 hours. Use it only when the user asks to delete the book. This cannot be undone.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_upload_link · Private data: fix_scan, create_upload_link, list_my_scans, delete_scan · Public sink: create_upload_link, delete_scan · Destructive: delete_scan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_upload_link · Private data: fix_scan, create_upload_link, list_my_scans, delete_scan · Public sink: create_upload_link, delete_scan · Destructive: delete_scan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
